capacity_interpretation: same maximum encoded budget; actual transmitted widths differ and are not equal capacity

default_exact_signature_audit.at_eight_groups: each one-categorical deletion has a distinct width; each exact signature has one mask
default_exact_signature_audit.reason_for_cap: exact widths are singleton constraints, so use a prefit maximum and report actual widths
default_exact_signature_audit.signature: numeric group count, categorical group count, exact encoded-column count

mask_alias_rule: same selected groups alone is not a fitted-release alias; heads/calibrators/views/budget must also match

profile_choice_evidence.decision_basis: task-only utility evidence and symbolic alternatives; historical SEX AUC did not rank the profile
profile_choice_evidence.task_utility: point-feasible against both U0 and Ucal for income and occupation; simultaneous intervals unresolved

union_geometry_limit: Distinct one-categorical deletions jointly disclose all 83 encoded columns. A shared deletion has a unique reduced union width, so an exact union-width control can legitimately choose the identical mask pair and tie.
union_identity_rule: same source-order raw union may be information-equivalent even when complete serialized releases differ
